mapper.select: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bb.preferencetag_tbl GROUP BY tag ORDER BY count DESC, tag ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT matchId, creatorId, title, createAt, startTime, DATE_FORMAT(startTime, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS formattedStartTime, status, location, url, anonymousCondi, mannerCondi, genderCondi, chatCode, people, kategorie FROM bb.match_tbl WHERE startTime >= NOW() ORDER BY startTime ASC LIMIT 9

SELECT m.matchId, m.title, m.status, m.startTime, m.location, t.tag FROM match_tbl m LEFT JOIN matchtag_tbl t ON m.matchId = t.matchId WHERE m.status = 0 AND m.matchId IN ( SELECT DISTINCT m2.matchId FROM match_tbl m2 LEFT JOIN matchtag_tbl t2 ON m2.matchId = t2.matchId WHERE ( m2.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t2.tag LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m2.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
